profile.headline: Senior Principal Engineer at Red Hat
profile.summary: Software architect and engineer specializing in high performance networking and virtualization technologies.  Emphasis on technical leadership and a deep understanding of foundational technologies, combined with broad experience in networking, container and VM virtualization, and embedded systems results in bringing technically complex features from design through implementation.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Product architecture and software engineering for Virtualized Networking platform.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineering for Virtualized Networking Platforms.
(Acquired by ADVA)

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Development of high performance computing platforms and applications which coupled FPGAs, embedded processors, multi-channel DDR3 memory, and high speed serial links.  

Applying signal and power integrity expertise to "Silicon Circuit Board" based embedded computing module products.

positions.title: Staff Research Engineer
positions.description: Developed revolutionary technology for a novel FPGA design methodology based on academically proven principles of dataflow networks of Actors. Core member of a team which proved dataflow as an abstraction for high performance FPGA design and transitioned the technology to product division. Developed high level language synthesis technology for automated compilation of software languages (C/Java/CAL) to hardware circuits.

positions.title: Senior Hardware/Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of select strategic development team researching high level language synthesis – Java to HDL – under DARPA contract.  Developed high performance hardware circuits for compiler mapping.

positions.title: Hardware Development Engineer
positions.description: Development of high speed protocol processing systems for satellite communication ground stations.  Hardware design, test, integration, debug.

positions.title: Intern -- Code 521: Microelectronics Systems Branch
positions.description: Development of digital componentry for satellite telemetry groundstations including design, development, initial test software and integration tasks.

positions.description: Development of digital componentry for satellite telemetry groundstations including design, test and integration tasks.
